title: Professional License Reciprocity Checker
description: Checks reciprocity and endorsement eligibility for 10 licensed professions across all 50 states plus DC using official interstate compact and reciprocity agreement data. Covered professions: RN/LPN (eNLC), physician (IMLC), CPA (NASBA SE), PE/structural engineer (NCEES comity), K-12 teacher (NASDTEC), real estate broker/agent (ARELLO bilateral), attorney, cosmetologist, social worker, and contractor. Tab 1: single-profession state-to-state check. Tab 2: multi-state batch checker for relocation planning.
data_vintage: eNLC 2026 (37 states) · IMLC 2026 (37 states) · NASBA SE (all 54) · NCEES comity (all 50+DC) · NASDTEC (all 50+DC) · ARELLO bilateral pairs 2025

origin_state.description: Two-letter state code where license is held

target_states.description: One or more target state codes to check reciprocity eligibility

pathway.description: Compact / endorsement / full exam / not available
